column1: # 12 NON-TUBERCULOUS MYCOBACTERIA runs. These are NEGATIVE CONTROLS, not
# benchmark subjects: TB-Profiler targets MTBC only, and the mycobacterial
# organism profile is written against H37Rv.
# What this panel tests: that the pipeline REFUSES to interpret a non-MTBC
# genome against the MTBC profile, rather than silently producing drug calls
# for the wrong organism. A run here passes when its drugs come back
# UNSUPPORTED / NOT_ASSESSED and the species QC check fails loudly.
# expected_outcome states that contract per row, and the validator treats any
# RESISTANT or SUSCEPTIBLE call on these rows as a FAILURE.
# Every accession was retrieved from NCBI SRA. cohort_tier is B: deposited
# evidence checks pass, no publication reviewed.
